critical_code_review_comments: Analytics.jsx unused import: 'useState' is imported but never used (Analytics only uses useEffect + useMemo). Minor lint nit, non-blocking.

Analytics.jsx + Scenarios.jsx duplicate the projection-fetch + pvSeries debounce logic almost identically (~15 lines each). Consider extracting into a usePvProjection(scenario) hook to satisfy the DRY guideline.
Both Analytics.jsx and Scenarios.jsx use 'JSON.stringify(scenario)' as a useEffect dependency proxy. Functional but expensive on every render; a deep-equality compare via a ref would be cleaner.

downloadData('xlsx') in Scenarios.jsx returns early when !pv, but the button stays clickable while pv is still being computed. A disabled={!pv} on scenario-download-xlsx/csv would prevent confusing no-op clicks on the very first scenario open.
Monte Carlo's TRIALS=500 is now a hard-coded module constant; the comment says 'fixed - validated' but if backend ever raises this we'd need a single source of truth. Currently fine.
PvNetToFamilyChart subtitle correctly surfaces the delivery year (2072) and 3.0% discount rate inline - matches the agent-to-agent context note exactly.
